subject: Request: multi-year price safeguard + auto-rollback for Artemis Bio (deal)
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@artemisbio.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Turner <sara.turner@artemisbio.com>, legal@artemisbio.com
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Redwood proposal — request for pricing stability + renewal guard

Ben —

Thanks for the proposal. Artemis is willing to commit to a 36-month reserved capacity package provided we can agree on two commercial protections we listed below: 1) a 24-month price lock on the per-token rates (no increases on the unit price for two years) and 2) an annual uplift cap of 7% after year two for years three and beyond.

We also need a renewal protection clause: if we drop below 80% of committed usage in any renewal year, we can (a) step down to a smaller committed tier without penalty, or (b) receive a prorated credit — whichever is cleaner operationally. We understand this is non-standard, but this is required for our board to approve a 3-year commitment given forecast uncertainty.

I've attached Artemis' MOP requirements and a rough forecast. Can Redwood confirm feasibility and any required concessions?

Best,
Elena Morales
Head of Procurement, Artemis Bio
procurement@artemisbio.com

Attachment: artemis_mop_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <procurement@artemisbio.com>
Cc: Sara Turner <sara.turner@artemisbio.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 13:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — request for pricing stability + renewal guard

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the forecast — this is helpful. Short answer: we can meet the spirit of both asks with some adjustments. Before I put a formal mark-up in DocuSign, I want to confirm internal approvals for two non-standard items: (1) a 24-month hard price lock on the committed per-token rate (we'd require a commitment floor and a modest up-front discount), and (2) a renewal protection mechanism that avoids open-ended credits but gives Artemis a step-down option with defined thresholds.

Proposed commercial asks from our side:
- 10% one-time upfront commitment discount on the first invoice (applied to months 1–3) in return for the 24-month price lock.
- Uplift cap set to 7% / year post month 24 (aligns to your ask) but with an auto-rollback safety: if average utilization over the immediately prior 3 months falls below 75% of the committed baseline, pricing reverts to standard on a pro-rated basis (we'd like visibility windows to avoid churny behavior).

I'll loop in Vivek (Deal Desk) and our finance partner to confirm the accounting and margin thresholds. If you can accept the upfront discount + auto-rollback guard, we can commit to the language and circulate redlines next week.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: redwood_price_proposal_v3.pdf (proposal, 120KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal — request for pricing stability + renewal guard

Ben / Marissa —

Reviewed Artemis' ask and Ben's proposed trade. High-level take:
- 24-month hard price lock: OK provided we get the upfront commitment discount as proposed (10% on initial invoice window). This protects our per-unit economics while giving the customer predictability.
- 7% uplift cap: OK from a commercial perspective, but finance needs to sign off on revenue recognition and potential downside exposure.
- Auto-rollback: this is where we need executive clearance. The rollback language as written (revert to standard pricing pro-rated) introduces potential churn risk if customers oscillate around the threshold. I recommend: add a 60-day stabilization window before rollback triggers and limit automatic rollbacks to one occurrence every 12 months, unless both parties agree otherwise.

Two asks for approval: (A) approve the 24-month price lock with the 10% upfront concession; (B) approve the auto-rollback mechanism with the 60-day stabilization and 12-month frequency guard. If approved, I'll finalize redlines and send to legal.

Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Deal Operations, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

(On internal note — margin tolerance here sits at ~18% blended. Please keep that in mind when approving any further concession.)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Mark Markus <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Aug 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal — request for pricing stability + renewal guard

Team —

Thanks Vivek — this aligns with our playbook for strategic life-sciences accounts. I support the 24-month lock + 10% upfront concession. I also support the uplift cap at 7% and the stabilization/12-month guard for the rollback.

Markus — requesting your executive sign-off on the auto-rollback exception. This is a contract-level behavior that departs from standard non-guaranteed usage terms; approving it will set a precedent so want to be explicit. If you can greenlight the rollback language with the 60-day stabilization and single auto-rollback per 12 months, we can proceed to legal and aim to get counter-signed by Artemis next week.

Laura — a quick ask for you: confirm whether the 10% upfront concession can be applied as a credit spread across month 1–3 invoices for accounting simplicity (Ben proposed that earlier). If not, what alternate structures keep us within margin?

Marissa Cole
VP, GTM — Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: redwood-term-redlines-20270803.docx (term redlines, 24KB)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Aug 2027 18:03:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Redwood proposal — request for pricing stability + renewal guard

Folks —

Thanks for the succinct summary. I approve the ask on two conditions: (1) the 10% upfront concession must be mechanized as a credit applied across invoices for months 1–3 (no one-time write-off) to protect revenue recognition; and (2) the auto-rollback must include the 60-day stabilization window and be limited to one automatic rollback per 12-month period. Additionally, add a clause that rollback decisions are reviewable by both parties in writing before activation (email confirmation suffices).

With these controls, I'm comfortable making this an approved exception for Artemis. Please finalize redlines and route to legal and procurement. Ben — please confirm with Elena and get DocuSign on the path.

-Markus Klein
CRO (interim), Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com
